entities.summary: Mason Brayman was an American attorney, newspaperman, and military officer. During his service to the Union Army during the American Civil War, he rose to the rank of major general with the 29th Illinois Volunteer Infantry. Later in life, he became the seventh governor of the Idaho Territory.
